paper_metadata.title: Effect of carbon on cryogenic tensile behavior of CoCrFeMnNi-type high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: we examined cryogenic tensile behavior of the fcc high entropy alloys with different carbon content (0 e2 at.%). The alloys had non-equiatomic proportions of principal elements, i.e. Co1Cr0.25Fe1Mn1Ni1.
CoCr 0.25FeMnNi high entropy alloys
structure, mechanical properties and deformation mechanisms of the as-cast CoCr 0.25FeMnNi alloys doped with 0 e2 at.% of carbon were examined
Different amounts of carbon (the nominal concentrations were 0, 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 at.%) were added to the experimental alloys.
